clue.text: Computer used to examine and analyse gold

parts.note: to process data or material is to examine and analyse it
OR is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A machine is put to work assaying a quantity of gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A processor is the central chip of a machine that computes, standing for the whole device.

clue.text: Down-to earth approach exists in the kingdom

indicators.note: in places the word for exists inside the word for the kingdom

parts.note: a realm is a kingdom
is means exists, as in 'there is'

explanation.surface: A practical, no-nonsense attitude prevails throughout the land.
explanation.definitionFit: Realism is a practical outlook that faces facts as they are.

clue.text: One of the same rank to be a match for the commander first

indicators.note: first tells us the commander's letters come at the front of the charade

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for commanding officer
to equal someone is to be a match for them

explanation.surface: A soldier hopes to rival his commanding officer and reach parity.
explanation.definitionFit: A coequal is a peer, a person of equal standing with another.

clue.text: Lechery of Sarah going over a large town

indicators.note: in a down entry, going over places this name above the rest

parts.note: Sal is a pet form of the name Sarah
a city is a large town

explanation.surface: Sarah's lewd behaviour is spreading across a big town.
explanation.definitionFit: Salacity is lewdness or lustfulness, a synonym of lechery.

clue.text: Smoother wave?

explanation.surface: A question about something that flattens and also curls along the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A road roller flattens surfaces; a long swelling breaker at sea is also called a roller.

clue.text: A child of six

parts.note: reads as a six-year-old, but means one of six babies born at a single birth

explanation.surface: A youngster aged six.
explanation.definitionFit: One of a set of six offspring delivered together is so called.

clue.text: Peaceful water

explanation.surface: Calm water.
explanation.definitionFit: Pacific means peaceable, and the Pacific is the largest ocean.

clue.text: Take turns to change neat design

parts.note: to alter is to change

indicators.note: design asks for the letters of neat to be arranged afresh into a new pattern

explanation.surface: A suggestion that people swap roles to rework a tidy layout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' turns NEAT into NATE, which follows ALTER.
explanation.definitionFit: To alternate is to do things by turns, one after the other.

clue.text: On the whole it provides protection

explanation.surface: Generally speaking, this keeps you covered.
explanation.definitionFit: Overall means taken as a whole; overalls are a protective work garment.

clue.text: Man with a girl on his knee

parts.note: Pat is a man's name
Ella is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A fellow sits with a young woman perched on his lap.
explanation.definitionFit: The patella is the kneecap, the bone at the front of the knee.

clue.text: Room in the French network

indicators.note: in puts the room inside the French article

parts.note: le is French for 'the'
an attic is a room under the roof

explanation.surface: A space within a French communication system.
explanation.definitionFit: A lattice is a criss-cross framework, a network of strips.

clue.text: Without another clue, that's very unimportant!

parts.note: minus means without

indicators.note: another signals a different version of the word clue, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A solver dismisses something as trivial once one more hint is lacking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' turns CLUE into CULE, which follows MINUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Minuscule means tiny, so of very little importance.

clue.text: Catty in a big way?

parts.note: catty suggests spiteful, but here means like a big cat, a lion

explanation.surface: Being extremely spiteful.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonine means lion-like, of the largest-maned big cat.

clue.text: Bursting forth into pure chaos

indicators.note: chaos means the letters of the words before it are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Something breaks out and descends into utter disorder.
explanation.definitionFit: An eruption is a violent outbreak, as of a volcano.

clue.text: Slipper included by a model used as a charm

indicators.note: included by puts the slipper inside the letters for a and model

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car, so T stands for model
a mule is a backless slipper

explanation.surface: A fashion model carries a slipper as a lucky token.
explanation.definitionFit: An amulet is a talisman worn to ward off harm.

clue.text: Found in the centre of Hull?

definitions.text: Found in the centre of Hull?

parts.words: Found in the centre of Hull?
parts.note: Hull reads as the English city, but means a ship's body, whose middle part is meant

explanation.surface: Something located in the middle of the Yorkshire city of Hull.
explanation.definitionFit: Amidships means in the middle of a vessel.

clue.text: Spend carefully or save

explanation.surface: Advice to be thrifty with money.
explanation.definitionFit: To economise is to cut costs, both spending with care and putting by money.

clue.text: Candy ie recycled is poisonous

definitions.note: an adjective for a noun naming a poison

indicators.note: recycled means the letters of candy and ie are processed into a new form

explanation.surface: A warning that a recycled sweet is toxic.
explanation.definitionFit: Cyanide is a deadly poison.

clue.text: Clear space, but it's not there at night

explanation.surface: A gap that disappears after dark.
explanation.definitionFit: Daylight is a clear gap between things, and natural light absent after sunset.

clue.text: Stained but could be the same colour

indicators.note: could be suggests the word same is reshaped into another order

parts.note: red is a colour

explanation.surface: Marked with dirt, yet perhaps all one shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' turns SAME into SMEA, followed by RED.
explanation.definitionFit: Smeared means daubed or marked with a greasy streak.

clue.text: A man of no spirit and passion not starting to dress

parts.note: TT means teetotal, a person who drinks no spirits

indicators.note: not starting drops the first letter of the word for passion

parts.note: fire means passion or ardour

explanation.surface: A dull, sober fellow lacking any fervour begins to get dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not starting' takes F from FIRE, leaving IRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Attire is clothing, so to attire is to clothe.

clue.text: Not win game with Venetian painter

parts.note: a tie is a draw, a result that is not a win
polo is a game played on horseback

explanation.surface: A drawn match of a sport involving an artist from Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo was an eighteenth-century painter from Venice.

clue.text: Bump and meet an old friend perhaps

explanation.surface: Colliding with someone and recognising a long-lost pal.
explanation.definitionFit: To run into is to collide with, and to meet by chance.

clue.text: Cheat a servant, that's the rule

parts.note: to do someone is slang for cheating them
a minion is a servile follower

explanation.surface: Swindling one's servant is the norm.
explanation.definitionFit: Dominion is sovereign authority, power to govern.

clue.text: Having about now, gin cocktail

indicators.note: cocktail means the words now and gin are mixed together

explanation.surface: Enjoying a gin mixed drink right now.
explanation.definitionFit: Owning means possessing, a synonym of having.

clue.text: Fit person's welfare

parts.note: well means healthy, fit
a being is a person, a living creature

explanation.surface: A healthy individual's state of comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: Wellbeing is health and happiness, a near synonym of welfare.

clue.text: Phrenologist leading the tribe?

parts.note: a phrenologist studies skull bumps, a man of heads, while a chief leads a tribe

explanation.surface: A reader of skull bumps in charge of a tribe.
explanation.definitionFit: A headman is the chief of a village or tribe.

clue.text: Silver ball on the beach

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a round is a ball, a round object

explanation.surface: A silver ball lies on the sand.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship aground is stranded on the shore.

clue.text: Journalists, despite receiving no backing, continue energetically

parts.note: the press is journalists collectively

indicators.note: backing means the word no is turned to run back to front

explanation.surface: Reporters keep going despite receiving no support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns NO into ON, which follows PRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: To press on is to persevere with determination.

clue.text: Drops toga in a crumpled condition-because there's a snail in it?

indicators.note: in a crumpled condition means the letters of drops toga are screwed up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone drops a toga in a heap, since a snail is inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A snail belongs to the class of molluscs called gastropods.
